requirements.statement: Trial balance close must be confirmed before the primary statements are drafted.
Whatever carries posting of period-end adjustments must still consume the approved period-end adjustment schedule.
Whatever carries consolidation must still consume intercompany balances and transactions (KB-14).
Whatever carries translation of the foreign operation must still consume closing and average exchange rates (KB-07, KB-08).
Whatever carries mapping to statement line items must still consume the statement line-item structure (KB-02).
Whatever carries posting of period-end adjustments must still consume revenue cut-off evidence (KB-13, KB-03).

required_inputs: Accounting policy change and prior-period error record

requirements.statement: Whatever carries drafting of the statements and notes must still consume the accounting policy change and prior-period error record (KB-05, KB-06).
Statement drafting and management approval must not be performed by the same actor.
Management review and approval must survive in some form.
Confirmation of trial balance close must survive in some form.
Drafting of the primary statements and key notes must survive in some form.

source.document_reference: APQC PCF Cross-Industry v8.0 (Feb 2026), process anchor pending verification (external financial reporting); step decomposition per docs/HELDOUT_SPEC_2026-10-10.md (signed off 10 Oct 2026). APQC activity IDs pending verification against PCF v8.0 text.

steps.description: Subledger closure and completion of reconciliations are confirmed, establishing the closed, reconciled trial balance.
steps.name: Confirm trial balance close

steps.description: Approved period-end adjustments (accruals, provisions, deferrals, cut-off) are posted, with revenue cut-off verified.
steps.name: Post period-end adjustments

steps.description: Entity trial balances are consolidated and intercompany balances and transactions are eliminated.
steps.name: Consolidation and intercompany elimination

steps.description: The foreign subsidiary's results and position are translated into the presentation currency, with translation differences taken to other comprehensive income.
steps.name: Translate foreign operation

steps.description: The consolidated trial balance is mapped to the statement line-item structure.
steps.name: Map trial balance to statement line items

steps.description: The primary statements and key notes (accounting policies, revenue, FX, errors) are drafted, including disclosure of policy changes and prior-period errors.
inputs: Accounting policy change and prior-period error record
steps.name: Draft primary statements and key notes

steps.description: The draft statements are analytically reviewed and tied out to the trial balance and supporting schedules.
steps.name: Analytical review and tie-out

steps.description: Management reviews and approves the financial statements.
steps.name: Management review and approval

steps.description: The approved financial statements are released or submitted.
steps.name: Release / submission
